name: saving_rate
label: Household saving rate
note: low saving may be hardship OR low precaution; high saving may be prudence OR demand collapse

name: working_hours
label: Actual weekly hours
note: long hours may be effort under strain OR simply more work available

name: real_wages_idx
label: Real wages, own 2008=100
note: nama_10_lp_ulc D1_SAL_PER deflated by prc_hicp_aind, rebased to own 2008

name: arop_threshold_real
label: Real AROP threshold, own 2008=100
note: ilc_li01 NAC, euro-changeover normalised (currency.py), HICP-deflated, own 2008 base

name: hicp
label: HICP inflation, headline
note: NOT a cross-country price level: an index of change

name: wadj_a01
label: Wage-adjusted price pressure
note: prc_ppp_ind price level / nominal compensation wage level; both EU27=100

name: work_effort_squeeze
label: Work-effort squeeze
note: OVERLAP: built from working_hours and hourly_comp, both also registered here

name: severe_mat_soc_deprivation
label: Severe material & social deprivation
note: EU-SILC affordability items: same instrument as the outcome

name: debt_to_income
label: Household debt to income
note: low debt may be resilience, deleveraging OR credit exclusion

name: arrears
label: Arrears on bills
note: EU-SILC self-report, same respondent and instrument as the outcome

name: warm
label: Cannot keep home adequately warm
note: EU-SILC self-report; also a component of severe material deprivation
